name: Ollie Hands Approval Relay
description: Relays the owner's Telegram 'approve <code>' / 'deny <code>' replies to the ollie-hands engine's /consent endpoint, closing the loop on confirm-tier (acts-as-Tushar / destructive / browser-commit) actions. Pre-LLM and integrity-preserving: the brain cannot forge or suppress an approval.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the plugin loads but the hook is a no-op.

ownerTelegramChatId.description: Telegram chat id whose 'approve/deny <code>' replies are honored. Only this id can approve.

consentUrl.description: The ollie-hands engine /consent endpoint (host Tailscale IP, reachable from WSL).

bearerToken.description: Bearer token for /consent. If empty, the plugin reuses the bearer already configured for the `hands` MCP server (no duplicated secret).

enabled.label: Relay enabled
enabled.help: When false, this plugin is inert. Flip true after the ollie-hands engine + `hands` MCP server are live.
